item1.paper_quote: main.tex (Oracle-sensitivity paragraph, ~line 367-384): "Of the 18 flagged case39 scenarios' 900 (scenario,action) pairs (18x50) under q-lims, 133 fail to converge; under alternative solver settings (init/iteration/tolerance), 25 of the 133 converge, 0 of the 25 clear --- non-convergence hides no fixes." Preceding sentence: "17 of 36 case39 fixable items flip (47%)" -- confirms 18 = 17 flips + the 1 base-diverging item which is itself one of those 17 flips (paper's own arithmetic, independently reproduced below).

a_shipped_settings_900pairs.note: enforce_q_lims=False (shipped/paper default), numba=False, max_iteration=30, no init/tolerance override -- literally certify_v2.py's solve().

scope_iii_menu_converged_lt50.note: This scope is explicitly NOT the paper's '18 flagged case39 scenarios' -- it spans 16 different item_ids (including item_id=19, which is never in the q-lims-flip 18-set) and is dominated by rung entries whose old_label is already INFEASIBLE (18/19 entries), not the TRICKY/EASY fixable scenarios the paper's sentence describes. Must not be conflated with the q-lims-flip 18-set.

c_reconciliation.closest_scope_to_102: scope_iii (menu_converged<50): sum=103, off by 1 -- not a match, and not the right scope regardless (see note above); no scope on disk produces exactly 102.

d_qlims_true_900pairs.note: enforce_q_lims=True, numba=False, max_iteration=30, no init/tolerance override -- same shipped numba/max_iteration as (a), q-lims turned on.

mechanistic_explanation.summary: The paper's printed '25 of 133 converge' (= critic_v2_checks.json's stored n_rescued_converge=25) was reproduced from critic_v2's OWN stored rescue_detail, and every one of those 25 successes converges ONLY under a settings-dict that OMITS max_iteration entirely (e.g. {'init':'dc'}, {'tolerance_mva':0.001}), which makes pandapower fall back to its true default max_iteration='auto' -- NOT the task's literal spec of 'max_iteration in {30, 500}' (always one of these two values, explicitly passed, for every one of the 11 alternatives). Not one of critic_v2's 25 rescues converges under any combo that explicitly sets max_iteration=500 together with other overrides. This pass's 11 alternatives always pass max_iteration explicitly (30 or 500, per the task's literal factorial), so pandapower's 'auto' behavior -- whatever it actually does internally -- is never invoked, and the 6 pairs that only rescued via 'auto'-max_iteration combos in critic_v2's run do not rescue here.

d_qlims_true_rescue.verdict: CORRECTED. Under the task's literal 11-combo spec (max_iteration always explicit, 30 or 500, never left at pandapower's true default), 19/133 converge under >=1 alternative, not 25/133. 0/133 clear either way, so the paper's substantive claim ('non-convergence hides no fixes') is unaffected. The paper's printed count (25) should either be re-derived with max_iteration held explicit in every alternative, or the alternative-settings list should be documented precisely (it is currently under-specified in main.tex, which just says 'alternative solver settings (init/iteration/tolerance)').

item3.verdict: true-drop (both numerator and denominator exclude the dropped item) is the mathematically consistent accounting for a 'dropped, not relabeled' item; critic_v3's 75/36 denominators keep the item in the denominator while dropping it only from the numerator, which is inconsistent with that literal wording.
